correctness.rationale: For coordinate generator columns v_i in F_(q^m)^l, evaluation kernels coincide iff columns are Frobenius conjugate; CRT identifies generated algebra as product of residue fields indexed by occupied orbit classes, with orbit length d giving F_(q^d). Mobius inversion yields h_d=(1/d)sum_{e|d}mu(e)q^(d*l/e). Labelled occupancy of each orbit of size d gives weight 1+z_d(e^(dt)-1) and the full exact EGF. At N=q^(m*l), r~c sqrt(N), index-two subfield columns (even m only) are Bin(r,N^-1/2)->Pois(c), other proper subfields negligible. Full-degree orbit pair collisions with h_m=N/m+O(sqrt N) converge by factorial moments to Pois(mc^2/2), higher repeats vanish, conditional independence holds, and lost dimensions are m per collision or m/2 per index-two draw. The limit includes m=1, c=0. Independently enumerated all 256 generator arrays for q=2,m=2,l=2,r=2 and verified orbit profiles against an exact occupancy polynomial; finite enumeration corroborates, not proves limit.

Its parity-sensitive two-source critical compound-Poisson defect distinguishes collisions from index-two subfield trapping, a mathematically significant distributional mechanism at the natural birthday threshold.

final_claim: For uniform random generators of the unital finite etale algebra (F_{q^m})^r, the exact joint field-factor type law is a Frobenius orbit occupancy EGF and in r/q^(m*l/2)->c with fixed q,m the dimension defect converges to m Pois(mc^2/2)+1_{2|m}(m/2) Pois(c), independent terms.
